introText: The Samba Solar Track controller works on its own. This adapter shows its state and receives its messages.
ipHelp: IP address or host name, shown at the display under setup > network
tokenHelp: Shown at the display under setup > network > remote access. Without a token the adapter only reads.
forwardLevelLabel: Write messages of the device to the ioBroker log
forwardLevelHelp: All messages are stored in the states under messages, whatever is chosen here
historySizeHelp: Number of messages kept in messages.history (1 to 500)
